CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/presentation as coordinate set, and an explicit origin/status field are present for the same node/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to content organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content-identification entries list colors and coordinate sets for named nodes (current and candidate).

D.rationale: Origins/status fields explicitly differentiate completed records from inherited/current candidate records, attributing status to the identified contents.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate-set presentations) for current and candidate records.
